## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm verify --e2e` is green.
- [ ] A behaviour or data-model change has an ADR.
- [ ] User-facing strings exist in RU and EN.
- [ ] Colours and sizes come from design tokens.
- [ ] Tests cover the change where it can be tested.
- [ ] `content/help` or `guide/` updated when the user-visible workflow changed.
